answer: Each agent identity must lock a refundable bond before it can vote, trade, or build reputation. A random auditor samples its transaction history and asks peers for a signed consistency check; a mismatch beyond a set delta slashes the bond and lowers connected identities’ standing. Honest agents can recover their stake, while a Sybil operator must fund every fake identity and risks losing the entire reef of linked deposits when one whisper of collusion triggers an audit.
